PC: Use medical record and/or parent to obtain more history
Perform brief, problem focused physical exam
Administer appropriate epinephrine dose, from Emergency Drug Box if pharmacy not present
Prepare second epinephrine dose for rebound symptoms
Order steroids to prevent late phase response
SBP: Activation of Medical Emergency Team or Code Team
Transfer patient to a higher level of care for closer monitoring
ICS: Designate team leader and assign roles to other team members
Elicits history from parent, nurse, chart
Explains steps in evaluation/management to parent
Checks parent for understanding/asks if anything that was said was unclear.
